text: “Mamma,” said I, as soon as I could find an opportunity of speaking with her alone, “my money is but little, and cannot last long; if I could increase it, it would lessen papa’s anxiety, on one subject at least. I cannot draw like Mary, and so the best thing I could do would be to look out for another situation.” “And so you would actually try again, Agnes?” “Decidedly, I would.” “Why, my dear, I should have thought you had had enough of it.” “I know,” said I, “everybody is not like Mr. and Mrs. Bloomfield—” “Some are worse,” interrupted my mother.
